Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Bernard Braden had only two children (Christopher and Kelly), treating Kim Braden as dubious despite credible indications (and later explicit confirmation on Wikipedia) that he had three children, including Kim. This misinterpretation and confirmation bias led the process toward an incomplete/incorrect answer and persisted even after viewing the Wikipedia page that clearly stated “Children: 3, including Kim Braden.”
